title: Catalyst Reviewer Workbench
body: Problem: Catalyst reviewers spend too much time reading long proposals and manually checking evidence. Request: 180000 ADA to build an open-source reviewer workbench with source-grounded summaries, comparison rubrics, and audit logs. Impact: reviewers can triage proposals faster while preserving transparent citations. Feasibility: the team lists three milestones, TypeScript delivery experience, weekly demos, and public documentation. Risk: live Catalyst pages can change shape, so the project includes user-provided text fallback and sample fixtures. Missing evidence: pilot usefulness must be measured with real reviewers.
